title: Qwen3.6-27B sole-Q5T16 source-shaped dense integer MMQ screen

candidate.description: Adapt the in-tree llama.cpp-shaped I128/J128/K256 Q5_K x K-major Q8_1 DS4 integer-WMMA consumer to decode the existing sole-resident Q5T16 bytes. Metadata and quant planes are expanded into the same bounded 57,856-byte LDS class; no raw-Q5 or alternate persistent sidecar is added.

audit.why_nonduplicative: Prior Qwen3.6-27B Q5 integer screens covered rows 2-4 raw-Q5 and Q5T16 sudot4/DP4A row reuse. The source-shaped I128/J128/K256 integer-WMMA route had only been implemented for raw Q5_K and had not consumed the production sole-resident Q5T16 format.

correctness.focused_candidate_gate: 5 passed during implementation for rows 17/128/129 plus registry, gfx1151 exclusion, shape validation, lifecycle, finiteness, and project KL/top-1 thresholds

measurements.protocol: Actual immutable Qwen3.6-27B Q5T16 tensor, deterministic BF16 M512 activation, three warmups, nine counter-ordered HIP-event samples, five launches per event timing.

validation.post_removal_original_q5_source_gate: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q tests/test_gguf_q5_k_mmq_wmma_prefill.py --tb=short -> 8 passed

decision: Reject and remove the T16 consumer, wrapper, tests, and gfx1151 exclusion. The integer consumer alone is already 3.04% slower than retained FP16 WMMA, and Q8_1 packing raises the production projection regression to 4.40%. No runtime/default, decode, MTP, resident layout, or tracked memory changes survive. Dense Q5 integer MMQ is exhausted absent a materially different weight-consumer dataflow or hardware/compiler change.
